correctness.rationale: The two circuits produce a balanced reversal-closed subgraph with 2m edges of 240 nonpalindromic 4-arcs. Every uniform vertex has even chosen indegree at most 2, forcing u>=4 omitted pairs. At the 12 vertices aab, full out-in=1, so missing outgoing minus incoming=12; U supplies at least u missing incoming and no missing outgoing arcs, and only six aabb/bbaa classes can have two T-tails. Thus 12+u<=r-u+6, r>=14 and m<=106. A complete executable check validates every one of the 106 windows and reversal classes of the literal witness.
